Free Ask a Nurse Hotline

LCMC Health registered nurses answer health questions and help new and existing patients identify an appropriate next step for care.

The hotline offers a convenient place to ask about symptoms, services, and where to seek care when you are unsure whom to contact.

View hotline details
fields.pageSummary: Talk with an LCMC Health registered nurse about health questions and where to seek care.
